item.scarcity.camel_pack.description: A wearable liquid tank that keeps you hydrated.
item.scarcity.advanced_camel_pack.descri: A large wearable liquid tank that keeps you hydrated.
item.scarcity.unlimited_camel_pack.descr: A wearable liquid tank that collects water from the air to keep you hydrated.
item.scarcity.stillsuit.insulation: Significantly insulates you from extreme temperatures.
item.scarcity.stillsuit.moisture: Recycles moisture to reduce your water use.
item.scarcity.desert_armor.description: Light and breathable clothing that provides protection from the blazing heat.
item.scarcity.snow_armor.description: Warm clothing that provides protection from the freezing cold.
item.scarcity.crook.description: The Crook is a tool for harvesting leaves. It increases sapling drops and adds a chance to drop silkworms.
item.scarcity.crushing_hammer.descriptio: The Crushing Hammer is used to smash blocks into other blocks and items. For example, it can crush cobblestone into gravel, gravel into sand, and sand into dust. It can also crush deepslate, netherrack, blackstone, and end stone into siftable versions.
modifier.scarcity.heavy_hammering.flavor: Strong enough to smash compressed blocks
modifier.scarcity.heavy_hammering.descri: The hammer can break compressed blocks like a compressed hammer.
item.scarcity.sieve_heavy_augment.desc: Allows the Particulate Sieve to also process compressed blocks, at much higher power cost and lower speed.
info.scarcity.machine_sieve: Automatically sifts materials through a mesh, like an Ex Deorum sieve. Install a Heavy Agitator to process compressed blocks at higher power cost and lower speed.
